achievement.title: SuryoJasvi AI Festival 2025
achievement.project: Automated Insight with Assured Brand Integrity
achievement.description:
Our team won First Place 🥇 at the SuryoJasvi AI Festival 2025 and received a ₹50,000 prize for our project, “Automated Insight with Assured Brand Integrity.”

We built an AI-driven automation API to process and evaluate business data using:
• LangChain and Gemini for contextual analysis
• Hugging Face NLP models for classification and insights
• Python rules tailored to business requirements
• Pandas for data processing
• FastAPI for the API service
• MS SQL for input and output data
• n8n for continuous workflow automation

The API evaluates database records using AI and rule-based checks, then stores the results. It can run on demand or continuously. The project strengthened our technical and teamwork skills and showed how LLMs, automation, and business logic can work together.
